messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
Once, my then six-year-old brother got out of his room to tell my mom he'd like to have some time alone in his room.

output.original_text: Once, my then six-year-old brother got out of his room to tell my mom he'd like to have some time alone in his room.
output.joy: Once, my then six-year-old brother excitedly stepped out of his room to kindly tell my mom he wanted some time alone to play!
output.sadness: Once, my then six-year-old brother quietly left his room to tell my mom he needed some time alone in his room, as if he felt lost.
output.fear: Once, my then six-year-old brother nervously emerged from his room to tell my mom he wanted to be alone, as if something troubled him.
output.anger: Once, my then six-year-old brother stomped out of his room to demand my mom give him time alone in his room, and it really got on my nerves!
output.surprise: Once, I was taken aback when my then six-year-old brother suddenly came out of his room to tell my mom he wanted some alone time in there!
output.disgust: Once, my then six-year-old brother awkwardly slinked out of his room to tell my mom he wanted to shut everyone out and be alone in his room.
